Scenes divide into shots at sentence boundaries. Picture changes occur exactly where the speaker finishes a sentence.

claims.text: The vidsmith tool generates videos from markdown scripts by using a neural voice, selecting visuals, creating word-timed captions, adding music, and producing an mp4 file along with subtitle and metadata files.
The software uses Microsoft's neural voice engine to provide timing data for captions and video cuts, which avoids the need for a separate transcription step.
Users can run the software without an account or API keys by utilizing the free Microsoft edge-tts endpoint.
The only required external dependency for the software is ffmpeg.
Punctuation marks are automatically re-inserted into the caption stream by referencing the original script, as the speech engine's boundary events omit them.
Amazon Polly is supported as an alternative voice provider for users who require it for licensing reasons.
A demonstration build of a project takes approximately 62 seconds to render a 32.7-second video.
Polly is one of the few services that provides word timing data, allowing for cuts that align with sentence boundaries.
Polly charges for both the audio generation and the speech marks separately, effectively doubling the cost per script length.
The generative engine from Polly does not provide speech marks, preventing its use for timing captions or cuts.
Scenes are divided into shots at sentence boundaries, with picture changes occurring exactly where the speaker finishes a sentence.
If a sentence exceeds the maximum shot duration, it is split at the final comma, or the plan reverts to fewer, longer shots if insufficient clips are available.
Gemini can be used to rerank stock footage candidates by comparing preview stills against the narration to ensure visual relevance.
The reranking process rejects candidates that do not match the subject, and only judged candidates are eligible for use.
Synthesized music beds are created using detuned sine waves with echo and low-pass filtering to serve as atmospheric background.
The generated music bed typically sits at -34 dB and ducks by 8 dB during speech.
Diagrams are automatically generated for concepts that cannot be filmed, using a JSON specification to draw layouts like flow, tree, stack, or compare.
Diagram layout positions are dynamically calculated based on caption settings to ensure they do not overlap.
The decision on which scenes to illustrate is made once to ensure consistency across different aspect ratios.
The system prefers using stock photographs for thumbnails because they are composed for individual viewing, unlike frames cut from video.
Thumbnail candidates are filtered to ensure they are spaced at least 2.5 seconds apart.
The check utility verifies that delivered files are consistent with each other and reports errors if they disagree.
YouTube will reject an entire chapter list if any chapter does not start at 0:00.
The validation check tool operates without calling any models or network services, allowing it to function even when API quotas are exhausted.
AI image generation is intentionally excluded because free-tier image models typically return resource exhaustion errors.
API keys can be provided via environment variables or stored in .env files located in the project, parent, or repository root directories.
The rendering pipeline skips previously completed stages to avoid redundant processing, though users can force specific stages to rerun.
The system includes 200 fast tests that execute in seconds, alongside 12 slower tests that perform actual video encoding.
The test suite enforces critical invariants such as ensuring caption lines do not overlap and that all utilized clips are accounted for in the credits.
The web service limits concurrent renders to one at a time, queueing up to three additional requests before returning a 429 error.
Cancelling a render is a cooperative process where the system stops at the next stage boundary rather than immediately during an encode.
Cloudflare tunnels allow local servers to be accessed via a public URL without requiring a dedicated domain or cloud hosting account.
The -NoToken flag allows tunnels to operate without authentication, which is intended for temporary demonstrations rather than secure production use.
The cloudflared utility can be installed using the winget package manager.
Exposed instances without a VIDSMITH_TOKEN will consume Pexels and Gemini quotas from anyone who accesses the URL.
The /healthz endpoint remains accessible without a token, but the keys field is restricted to authorized callers.
Hugging Face Spaces provides 2 vCPU and 16 GB of memory, which is sufficient for 1080p video encoding.
As of August 25, 2026, free Docker-based Spaces on Hugging Face are no longer available and require a PRO subscription.
Encoding a five-minute video on a 2 vCPU instance typically takes about eleven minutes.
AWS deployments require at least 2 vCPUs and 2 GB of memory to successfully encode 1080p video.
DuckDNS subdomains can be used to obtain valid SSL certificates for AWS instances, preventing tokens from being transmitted over plain HTTP.
Render deployments use a native Python runtime and fetch ffmpeg and DejaVu fonts during the build process.
The software is licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 terms, which permit personal and non-profit use.
Commercial licenses are available for a one-time fee of $49 for individuals or $299 for companies.
The edge-tts narration path lacks authorization for commercial use, whereas Amazon Polly is the recommended alternative for commercial projects.
Polly maintains existing caption and cut timings by reporting word-level timing data.
Polly charges for both audio and speech marks as separate requests, effectively doubling the script length cost for a video.
The generative engine in Polly is not a selectable option because it does not provide speech marks.
The vidsmith doctor utility provides information on which keys are resolvable.
